strongest_angle: An analytical breakdown of the escalating military build-up, troop incursions, and mutual accusations between Ethiopia and Eritrea along the Tigray border following the September 23 armed rebellion by the TPLF.

key_facts.fact: Eritrean troops have deployed in Ethiopia's northern Tigray region as multiple sources confirmed on Wednesday, threatening an escalation into regional war.
Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion of its northern Tigray region in a letter sent to the United Nations Security Council.
The Tigray People's Liberation Front launched an armed rebellion on 23 September, according to the International Crisis Group report.

quotes.text: Ethiopia has accused Eritrea of an "all-out invasion" of its northern Tigray region and warned it will defend itself, days after residents told the BBC Eritrean troops had crossed into the country.
quotes.speaker: Hafsa Khalil
